editorial.marketOverview: Friday's shortened cash session remains the latest observation. Reuters reports Nasdaq +2.31%, SOX about +4.7% and NVDA +0.8%. AP reports broad S&P participation, about four in five advancing. Repository QQQ +2.69% and score -13 indicate a broad rebound but mixed model conditions.
editorial.whatChanged: The repository score remains -13 at 2026-11-27 21:36 ET. Open Watch refreshed at 2026-11-28T02:31:23+00:00; latest dated events remain November 25. Reuters and WSJ now corroborate Brent $95.44 and WTI $83.08 settlements, both lower on Friday. AP reports a different Brent quote, so contract and timing differences remain unresolved.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Chip relative strength offsets restrictive Fed expectations but NVDA lag and elevated yields limit conviction. Repository 10Y 4.936% and 2Y 4.710% imply 22.6 basis points; no extra scaling is warranted. Oil supply risk remains despite lower daily settlements. VXN and exact Fed probabilities are stale; no live weekend market response is established.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday November 30 tests the relief rally under normal liquidity and after Sunday's OPEC+ meeting. Tuesday December 1 brings ISM manufacturing (55 consensus) and JOLTS (7.45 million consensus) at 10 ET; CRDO earnings remain repository-listed. Wednesday December 2 ADP at 08:15 ET (80,000 consensus) could shift rate expectations ahead of Friday payrolls. Hearing dates remain unverified.
editorial.bullCase: Sustained SOX outperformance, broad participation and cooling volatility with stable yields could extend the recovery. Lower oil prices would help reduce inflation pressure if sustained.
editorial.bearCase: A reversal in semiconductor leadership or breadth, renewed oil supply disruptions or yields above 5% could unwind the holiday rally. AI financing, governance and trade uncertainty remain unresolved.
editorial.watchNext: Watch Sunday OPEC+ outcome, Monday futures and cash breadth, paired Treasury yields, fresh VXN/VIX and oil contracts. Compare Tuesday and Wednesday data with consensus and verify earnings and hearing dates.
